scope: Static/CPU test review only; no runner invocation, GPU, simulation, service, API, lock, or production mutation.
verified_behavior: speed/d0 phase is inert without --run and a read-only non-symlink admission.
Each phase loops X then Y: exactly two AIPerf invocations with request-count=2 and concurrency=2, therefore four generation calls.
AIPerf command uses raw export and no server metrics/GPU telemetry; raw and profile_export metrics must have exactly two unique matching x_request_id values.
Per-request decode TPS derives from raw metrics inter-token latency in ms; X requires two 256-token length completions; both groups enforce TPS >=7.8.
Before/after /proc snapshots require configured PID start tick equality, detect PID reuse, and retain service/thread state receipts.
D0 cursor reads only rows appended after each group, filters bs=2, records rids and labels m as deduplicated shared-batch equivalent, not independent UID m.
preregistration_boundary: INPUT_FREEZE declares P1/P2 and m scope, but runner does not hash-verify INPUT_FREEZE or independently decide P1/P2. Root readonly admission must bind this INPUT_FREEZE hash and the applicable preregistration artifact, alongside runner/input hashes and phase deadline.
fresh_cpu_validation: python -m pytest tests/test_allxy_runner.py -q -> 3 passed in 0.20s, including actual R045 wave1 raw+sibling-metrics fixture.
timeout_fix: TimeoutExpired stdout/stderr are normalized from bytes to text before write; static inspection confirms no type error at receipt write.
limitations: This approves source readiness only; it does not establish measurement results or production acceptance.
